text: dsh-chat-anchor 是供 DSH 网页聊天使用的客户端插件：发送新消息时，它把本地回声或最新用户提问锚定在聊天区上方，让回复在下方增长，减少长回复期间页面自动滚到底部、提问离开视野的情况。插件通过聊天视图的 DOM 属性观察消息列，并调整滚动位置及短回复所需的底部留白；滚轮、触摸、点击或键盘滚动会把控制权交还给用户。它还会区分历史加载与新提交，并在会话切换时恢复锚点、在视图卸载或插件禁用时清理监听和样式。适合希望按 Codex 式方式阅读 DSH 长对话的网页用户。代码未显示外部服务或密钥配置。
想让 DSH 网页聊天里刚发的问题一直留在上方，回答从下面继续显示。
DSH 回复一长页面就自动滚到底，怎么让提问保持在视野里？
How can I keep my latest prompt visible while a long DSH web reply streams below it?
dsh-chat-anchor 的「固定最新提问」功能：提交消息时把本地回声或新用户消息滚动锚定在聊天视口顶部附近，让回复在其下方增长。历史批量载入和会话切换会被识别为非新提交；用户滚轮、触摸、点击或按键滚动时会停止固定并交还视口控制权。

dsh-chat-anchor README · dsh-chat-anchor：**让 DeepSeek Harness 的网页聊天像 Codex 一样阅读：你刚发出的那条消息固定在聊天区顶部，回复向下生长，页面不再跟着滚到底部。**

[](LICENSE)

dsh-chat-anchor README · 它解决什么问题：dsh 的聊天区默认采用“跟随底部”策略：每次提交消息都会重新打开跟随，之后回复每长一点，整页就往下滚一点。长回复看到一半，自己刚问的那句话早就滚出视野了，只能手动往上拉——而下一条消息又会重置。

这个插件把交互反过来：

- 发送瞬间，你的消息就落到顶部；
- 回复在下面生长，视口保持不动；
- 需要看历史时正常往上滚，不会被抢回去。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 功能：- **发送即锚定**：不等服务端回显。按发送的同一帧里，本地回声气泡就被放到顶部，所以不会出现“先掉到底部再跳上来”的闪动。
- **短回复也能顶住**：回复比屏幕短时，消息列会补出“刚好够”的底部空白，并随着回复变长按 1:1 收缩——没有多余空白可以滚进去，回复填满屏幕后留白自然归零。
- **不打扰阅读**：滚轮、触摸、点击或翻页键一碰就交还控制权；往上滚再滚回底部，布局不会塌、也不会跳。「回到底部」按钮照常可用。
- **干净收尾**：加载历史、切换会话不会误触发；切视图或禁用插件时，留白和监听都会释放。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 安装：命令行：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-anchor
```

或者网页端：**插件 → 添加**，搜索 `dsh-chat-anchor`。

非默认 profile 需要加 `--profile <名称>`，例如：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-anchor
```

安装后**刷新页面**，浏览器才会加载新的客户端模块。不想用了，在同一个插件页禁用或卸载即可，不会改动 profile 里的其他配置。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 环境要求：| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（写在 `engines.dsh` 里） |
| 界面 | 网页 / 桌面版 Web UI（`dsh.client.platform: web`） |
| Host 半边 | 无——只有一个 patch 和一个客户端模块 |

插件 patch 只插入一行（`chat-anchor`），全部逻辑在 `client.js` 里；没有构建步骤，也没有运行时依赖。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 工作原理：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` 自己拥有“跟随底部”的滚动策略，而且没有开关。所以插件借用聊天视图已经公开的 DOM 契约来工作：

| 属性 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `[data-chat-flow]` | 滚动容器里的消息列 |
| `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]` | 一条用户消息行 |
| `[data-chat-turn]` | 这条消息所属的轮次 |
| `[data-submission-echo]` | 发送时先渲染的本地回声 |
| `[data-chat-following-tail]` | 跟随底部时，聊天框架上会有这个属性 |

插件把消息行滚到距顶部 160px 的位置（上一条消息的尾巴露得更多），滚动用 450ms 缓动，不会一下跳过去，Chat 会把这次位移判定为“读者移动”，从而释放跟随意图。短回复所需的底部留白由消息列上的 `::after` 规则（`--chat-anchor-space` 变量）提供，位置在 sticky 输入框之前，所以输入框始终停在窗口底部。
dsh-chat-anchor README · 工作原理：具体行为和边界条件写在 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [client.js](client.js) 的注释里。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 已知限制：这是一个**客户端适配**，不是官方扩展点。它依赖上面这些 `data-chat-*` 属性——它们属于 `ui-chat` 内部实现，任何版本都可能改动。改动后插件会静默失效，不会让页面崩溃。如果某次 dsh 升级后锚定失灵，请带上 dsh 版本提 issue。

长期的正解在上游：给 `ui-chat` 加一个跟随模式偏好。可以直接提交的方案（英文 issue 正文 + 中文设计说明）在 [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md)。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 排障：- **安装后没变化**：刷新页面，客户端模块是启动时加载的。
- **dsh 升级后失效**：多半是 DOM 契约变了。在浏览器控制台查看 `window.__dshChatAnchor`，它记录了版本、观察到的列、批次、回声、锚定次数和最近事件。
- **想关掉**：在插件页禁用或卸载 `dsh-chat-anchor`。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 开发：没有构建步骤，`client.js` 就是最终产物。

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查 Host 与 Client 两边
```

开发时把本目录作为本地 bundle 安装（和插件页的本地目录安装是同一个操作），每次修改后刷新页面。上游提案放在 [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md)。
dsh-chat-anchor README · 许可证：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

dsh-chat-anchor README · dsh-chat-anchor：**Codex-style reading for the DeepSeek Harness Web chat: the prompt you just sent stays at the top of the transcript and the answer grows downward, instead of the page following the bottom of every streamed reply.**

[](LICENSE)

dsh-chat-anchor README · The problem：The dsh transcript follows its bottom by default: every submission re-enables
tail following, and every later content commit keeps the scrollport on the
floor. While a long answer streams, your own question scrolls out of view; you
pull it back manually, and the next message resets it.

This plugin turns the interaction around:

- on send, your message lands at the top;
- the answer grows below it and the viewport stays put;
- scrolling up to read history is normal and is never yanked back.

dsh-chat-anchor README · What it does：- **Anchors on send**, not after the server round-trip: the local submission
  echo is placed at the top in the same task, before the browser paints, so the
  prompt never flashes at the bottom first.
- **Short answers still anchor**: the message column reserves exactly the bottom
  room the scroll range needs, and that room shrinks one-to-one as the answer
  grows. There is no extra blank to scroll into, and it disappears once the
  answer fills the screen.
- **Stays out of the way**: wheel, touch, pointer-down, or a scroll key hands
  the viewport back; scrolling up and back down does not collapse or jump the
  layout. The shipped *back-to-bottom* button keeps working.
- **Clean scope**: history loads and session switches are ignored; the room and
  observers are released when the view changes or the plugin is disabled.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Install：From the dsh CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-anchor
```

Or in the Web UI: **Plugins → Add**, search/enter `dsh-chat-anchor`.

Non-default profiles take `--profile <name>`, for example
`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-anchor`.

After installing, **reload the page** so the browser loads the new Client
module. Disable or remove the bundle from the same Plugins page to return to the
shipped behaviour; nothing else in the profile is touched.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`) |
| Surface | Web / Desktop Web UI (`dsh.client.platform: web`) |
| Host half | none — a patch-only bundle plus a Client module |

The bundle's patch inserts one row (`chat-anchor`) and the Client module does
all the work: no build step, no runtime dependency.

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` owns the bottom-follow policy and exposes no
setting for it, so the plugin works with the DOM contract the Chat view already
publishes:

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[data-chat-flow]` | the message column inside the transcript scrollport |
| `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]` | one human row |
| `[data-chat-turn]` | the turn that row belongs to |
| `[data-submission-echo]` | the local echo rendered on send |
| `[data-chat-following-tail]` | present on the frame while tail following is on |

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：It glides the row to 160px below the top of the scrollport over 450ms, which leaves more of the previous message visible above it. Chat
attributes scroll movement against its last acknowledged position, so the move
reads as reader movement and its sampling interval releases the follow intent.
The bottom room a short answer needs comes from a `::after` rule on the message
column (driven by `--chat-anchor-space`), placed before the sticky composer so
the composer keeps its place at the window foot.

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：The exact behaviour and edge cases are documented in [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)
and in the source comments of [client.js](client.js).

dsh-chat-anchor README · Limits：This is a Client-side adapter, not an official extension point. It depends on
the `data-chat-*` attributes above, which are internal to `ui-chat` and may
change in any release; when they do, the plugin fails silently rather than
crashing. If a dsh update breaks the anchoring, open an issue with the dsh
version.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Limits：The clean fix belongs upstream: a follow-mode preference in `ui-chat`. The
ready-to-submit proposal (English issue text and a Chinese design note) lives in
[`upstream/`](upstream/README.md).

dsh-chat-anchor README · Troubleshooting：- **Nothing changed after install**: reload the page; the Client module is
  fetched at boot.
- **Stopped working after a dsh update**: the DOM contract probably changed.
  Check `window.__dshChatAnchor` in the browser console — it records the
  version, observed columns, batches, journal additions, pins, and the last
  events.
- **Disable it**: turn off or remove `dsh-chat-anchor` in the Plugins page.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Development：No build step: `client.js` is the shipped browser module.

```sh
npm run check   # syntax-check both halves
```

Install a checkout as a local bundle (the same local-directory install the
Plugins page performs) and reload the page after each edit. The upstream
proposal for a first-class setting is kept in [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md).

dsh-chat-anchor keeps a newly sent DSH web prompt near the top as the reply grows below. It observes chat rows, adjusts scrolling, and adds needed room for short replies. Reader input cancels pinning; history is ignored, anchors restore on session switches, and disposal removes observers and styles.

dsh-chat-anchor README · dsh-chat-anchor：**让 DeepSeek Harness 的网页聊天像 Codex 一样阅读：你刚发出的那条消息固定在聊天区顶部，回复向下生长，页面不再跟着滚到底部。**

[](LICENSE)

dsh-chat-anchor README · 它解决什么问题：dsh 的聊天区默认采用“跟随底部”策略：每次提交消息都会重新打开跟随，之后回复每长一点，整页就往下滚一点。长回复看到一半，自己刚问的那句话早就滚出视野了，只能手动往上拉——而下一条消息又会重置。

这个插件把交互反过来：

- 发送瞬间，你的消息就落到顶部；
- 回复在下面生长，视口保持不动；
- 需要看历史时正常往上滚，不会被抢回去。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 功能：- **发送即锚定**：不等服务端回显。按发送的同一帧里，本地回声气泡就被放到顶部，所以不会出现“先掉到底部再跳上来”的闪动。
- **短回复也能顶住**：回复比屏幕短时，消息列会补出“刚好够”的底部空白，并随着回复变长按 1:1 收缩——没有多余空白可以滚进去，回复填满屏幕后留白自然归零。
- **不打扰阅读**：滚轮、触摸、点击或翻页键一碰就交还控制权；往上滚再滚回底部，布局不会塌、也不会跳。「回到底部」按钮照常可用。
- **干净收尾**：加载历史、切换会话不会误触发；切视图或禁用插件时，留白和监听都会释放。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 安装：命令行：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-anchor
```

或者网页端：**插件 → 添加**，搜索 `dsh-chat-anchor`。

非默认 profile 需要加 `--profile <名称>`，例如：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-anchor
```

安装后**刷新页面**，浏览器才会加载新的客户端模块。不想用了，在同一个插件页禁用或卸载即可，不会改动 profile 里的其他配置。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 环境要求：| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（写在 `engines.dsh` 里） |
| 界面 | 网页 / 桌面版 Web UI（`dsh.client.platform: web`） |
| Host 半边 | 无——只有一个 patch 和一个客户端模块 |

插件 patch 只插入一行（`chat-anchor`），全部逻辑在 `client.js` 里；没有构建步骤，也没有运行时依赖。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 工作原理：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` 自己拥有“跟随底部”的滚动策略，而且没有开关。所以插件借用聊天视图已经公开的 DOM 契约来工作：

| 属性 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `[data-chat-flow]` | 滚动容器里的消息列 |
| `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]` | 一条用户消息行 |
| `[data-chat-turn]` | 这条消息所属的轮次 |
| `[data-submission-echo]` | 发送时先渲染的本地回声 |
| `[data-chat-following-tail]` | 跟随底部时，聊天框架上会有这个属性 |

插件把消息行滚到距顶部 160px 的位置（上一条消息的尾巴露得更多），滚动用 450ms 缓动，不会一下跳过去，Chat 会把这次位移判定为“读者移动”，从而释放跟随意图。短回复所需的底部留白由消息列上的 `::after` 规则（`--chat-anchor-space` 变量）提供，位置在 sticky 输入框之前，所以输入框始终停在窗口底部。

dsh-chat-anchor README · 已知限制：这是一个**客户端适配**，不是官方扩展点。它依赖上面这些 `data-chat-*` 属性——它们属于 `ui-chat` 内部实现，任何版本都可能改动。改动后插件会静默失效，不会让页面崩溃。如果某次 dsh 升级后锚定失灵，请带上 dsh 版本提 issue。

长期的正解在上游：给 `ui-chat` 加一个跟随模式偏好。可以直接提交的方案（英文 issue 正文 + 中文设计说明）在 [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md)。

- **想关掉**：在插件页禁用或卸载 `dsh-chat-anchor`。

dsh-chat-anchor README · dsh-chat-anchor：**Codex-style reading for the DeepSeek Harness Web chat: the prompt you just sent stays at the top of the transcript and the answer grows downward, instead of the page following the bottom of every streamed reply.**

[](LICENSE)

dsh-chat-anchor README · The problem：The dsh transcript follows its bottom by default: every submission re-enables
tail following, and every later content commit keeps the scrollport on the
floor. While a long answer streams, your own question scrolls out of view; you
pull it back manually, and the next message resets it.

This plugin turns the interaction around:

- on send, your message lands at the top;
- the answer grows below it and the viewport stays put;
- scrolling up to read history is normal and is never yanked back.

dsh-chat-anchor README · What it does：- **Anchors on send**, not after the server round-trip: the local submission
  echo is placed at the top in the same task, before the browser paints, so the
  prompt never flashes at the bottom first.
- **Short answers still anchor**: the message column reserves exactly the bottom
  room the scroll range needs, and that room shrinks one-to-one as the answer
  grows. There is no extra blank to scroll into, and it disappears once the
  answer fills the screen.
- **Stays out of the way**: wheel, touch, pointer-down, or a scroll key hands
  the viewport back; scrolling up and back down does not collapse or jump the
  layout. The shipped *back-to-bottom* button keeps working.
- **Clean scope**: history loads and session switches are ignored; the room and
  observers are released when the view changes or the plugin is disabled.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Install：From the dsh CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-anchor
```

Or in the Web UI: **Plugins → Add**, search/enter `dsh-chat-anchor`.

Non-default profiles take `--profile <name>`, for example
`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-anchor`.

After installing, **reload the page** so the browser loads the new Client
module. Disable or remove the bundle from the same Plugins page to return to the
shipped behaviour; nothing else in the profile is touched.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`) |
| Surface | Web / Desktop Web UI (`dsh.client.platform: web`) |
| Host half | none — a patch-only bundle plus a Client module |

The bundle's patch inserts one row (`chat-anchor`) and the Client module does
all the work: no build step, no runtime dependency.

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` owns the bottom-follow policy and exposes no
setting for it, so the plugin works with the DOM contract the Chat view already
publishes:

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[data-chat-flow]` | the message column inside the transcript scrollport |
| `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]` | one human row |
| `[data-chat-turn]` | the turn that row belongs to |
| `[data-submission-echo]` | the local echo rendered on send |
| `[data-chat-following-tail]` | present on the frame while tail following is on |

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：It glides the row to 160px below the top of the scrollport over 450ms, which leaves more of the previous message visible above it. Chat
attributes scroll movement against its last acknowledged position, so the move
reads as reader movement and its sampling interval releases the follow intent.
The bottom room a short answer needs comes from a `::after` rule on the message
column (driven by `--chat-anchor-space`), placed before the sticky composer so
the composer keeps its place at the window foot.

dsh-chat-anchor README · How it works：The exact behaviour and edge cases are documented in [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)
and in the source comments of [client.js](client.js).

dsh-chat-anchor README · Limits：This is a Client-side adapter, not an official extension point. It depends on
the `data-chat-*` attributes above, which are internal to `ui-chat` and may
change in any release; when they do, the plugin fails silently rather than
crashing. If a dsh update breaks the anchoring, open an issue with the dsh
version.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Limits：The clean fix belongs upstream: a follow-mode preference in `ui-chat`. The
ready-to-submit proposal (English issue text and a Chinese design note) lives in
[`upstream/`](upstream/README.md).

dsh-chat-anchor README · Troubleshooting：- **Nothing changed after install**: reload the page; the Client module is
  fetched at boot.
- **Stopped working after a dsh update**: the DOM contract probably changed.
  Check `window.__dshChatAnchor` in the browser console — it records the
  version, observed columns, batches, journal additions, pins, and the last
  events.
- **Disable it**: turn off or remove `dsh-chat-anchor` in the Plugins page.

dsh-chat-anchor README · Development：No build step: `client.js` is the shipped browser module.

```sh
npm run check   # syntax-check both halves
```

Install a checkout as a local bundle (the same local-directory install the
Plugins page performs) and reload the page after each edit. The upstream
proposal for a first-class setting is kept in [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md).
